events.summary: Solid first cut with good confidence on native range, Florida introduction date, flowering phenology, size, pollinator ecology, trunk spines, and the silk-cotton/kapok distinction. Edibility is Yellow because flowers are eaten cooked in Asian cuisines but raw consumption in quantity is not advisable. Toxicity is Green — no known toxicity to people or pets per available sources, and Bombax ceiba does not appear on the ASPCA toxic plants list. FISC/FLEPPC: not listed. The Asian butterfly host (Bucculatrix crateracma) is real but irrelevant to Florida and has been noted only in the butterfly notes field.
